mechanism_narrative: A rise in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 3% year-over-year signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY > 3% and S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5 percentage points over the previous month signals a weakening labor market, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE increases > 0.5pp MoM and S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in Real Final Sales (RSAFS) over two consecutive quarters signals a weakening demand environment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS declines for 2 consecutive quarters and S&P 500 forward 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in Industrial Production (INDPRO) by more than 2% month-over-month signals supply chain disruptions, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO declines > 2% MoM and S&P 500 forward 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the Federal Funds Rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 5% and the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) is rising, the combination signals a tightening monetary policy environment with inflationary pressure, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS > 5% and CPIAUCSL is rising, but S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Nonfarm Payrolls (PAYEMS) combined with a decrease in the Unemployment Rate (UNRATE) signals a strong labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If PAYEMS increases and UNRATE decreases, but S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are negative in more than 45% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in Housing Starts (HOUST) signals a strengthening demand environment, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If HOUST increases and S&P 500 forward 60-day returns are negative in more than 45% of the instances.

mechanism_narrative: During a period of economic expansion, a rise in Industrial Production (INDPRO) by more than 1% month-over-month signals increased economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO increases > 1% MoM during economic expansion and S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are negative in more than 45% of the triggered instances.
